# OpenMarketEval A-Share Agent Arena

> Reproducible public league for A-share backtest forensics and research-agent evaluation.

## Entry points

- README: README.md
- Chinese README: README.zh-CN.md
- Forecast protocol: docs/protocol.md
- Benchmark design: docs/benchmark-design.md
- Roadmap: docs/roadmap.md
- A-share track catalog: benchmarks/a-share-lab/tracks.json
- Public source registry: benchmarks/a-share-lab/sources.json
- A-share lab specification: benchmarks/a-share-lab/README.md
- Current challenge: benchmarks/a-share-backtest-forensics/
- Current challenge cases: benchmarks/a-share-backtest-forensics/cases.jsonl
- Harbor A-share audit task: integrations/harbor/a-share-backtest-audit/
- Arena operating system: docs/arena-operating-system.zh-CN.md
- Live dashboard: https://alfonsobang.github.io/open-market-eval/
- Current live round: live/rounds/2026-08/
- Contributor rules: CONTRIBUTING.md
- Agent skill: skills/forecast-market-events/SKILL.md
- Harbor-style task: integrations/harbor/market-forecast/

## Commands

- Demo: `python -m open_market_eval demo`
- Validate: `python -m open_market_eval validate --questions <jsonl> --forecasts <jsonl>`
- Seal: `python -m open_market_eval seal <files...>`
- Score: `python -m open_market_eval score --forecasts <jsonl> --resolutions <jsonl>`
- Build dashboard: `python -m open_market_eval build-site --output site`
- List A-share tracks: `python -m open_market_eval list-tracks`
- Inspect one track: `python -m open_market_eval show-track --track backtest-audit`
- Run Challenge 0: `python -m open_market_eval audit-demo`
- Score an Agent: `python -m open_market_eval score-audit --submission <jsonl>`

## Safety boundary

Evaluate research process and probabilistic quality. Do not provide trade execution, investment recommendations, price targets, or guaranteed-return claims. The included audit score is a manually authored format fixture, not a model result.
